AggregationStrategy.description:
An aggregation strategy, compiled in and named after Camel's built-ins,
plus two JSON additions marked as such in
`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.6. Tagged by `type` on the
wire; every variant is a struct variant, the shape
`registry-platform-yaml`'s `tagged_union!` reads.

oneOf.description:
Keep the newest exchange: the default for `enrich`, which replaces
the body with the resource reply.

Keep the original exchange: the default for `split`. With
`propagateException` false, the split's item failures are
swallowed and the original message returns
(manual/split-eip.html, `UseOriginalAggregationStrategy`).

propagateException.description:
Whether an item failure is raised after the split completes;
Camel's default is true.

oneOf.description: Concatenate the split results into one list, Camel's `groupedBody`.

Append one array's elements into another, refusing a duplicate
`uniqueBy` value with the `aggregation.duplicate` class.

from.description: The array property the elements are appended into.

into.description: The message body member the array lands in.

properties.description:
Property names carried out of each reply, each naming a
singular `jsonpath` on the reply body; an absent selection
removes the property (section 8.11.7).

uniqueBy.description: Member whose value must stay unique across appended elements.

oneOf.description: Merge one JSON object into another. No duplicate refusal.

from.description: The object property merged into the body.

into.description: The message body member the object lands in.

properties.description:
Property names carried out of each reply, each naming a
singular `jsonpath` on the reply body; an absent selection
removes the property (section 8.11.7).

oneOf.description:
A custom strategy: a Rhai entrypoint over the old and new bodies,
named `oldExchange` and `newExchange` after Camel's own
`AggregationStrategy.aggregate`.

expression.description:
The script file and entrypoint, resolved against the pack's
script inventory.

Capabilities.description:
The engine capabilities a pack requires: the components, languages, and
EIPs its routes use. The ctl refuses a pack the binary cannot run
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 6).

components.description: The components the pack's routes reach.

eips.description: The EIPs the pack's routes use.

languages.description: The expression languages the pack's routes use.

ChoiceStep.description:
A `choice` step: first matching predicate wins, as Camel's Content-Based
Router.

CircuitBreakerStep.description:
A `circuitBreaker` step: resilience4j semantics and defaults
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7), per EIP node,
process-local. Divergence: a rejected call always raises
`breaker.open`, and `onFallback` runs on failure and on rejection.

failureRateThreshold.description:
Failure-rate percentage that opens the breaker (resilience4j
default 50).

minimumNumberOfCalls.description: Calls recorded before the breaker judges (default 100).

onFallback.description:
The fallback, run on failure and on rejection; its output is
validated like any route output.

openStateWaitSeconds.description:
Seconds the breaker stays open (resilience4j
`waitDurationInOpenState`, default 60).

slidingWindowCalls.description:
The count-based window size in calls (default 100); the window type
is fixed count-based and not configurable.

slowCallDurationThresholdSeconds.description: Seconds over which a call counts as slow (default 60).

slowCallRateThreshold.description: Slow-call-rate percentage that opens the breaker (default 100).

CodeMap.description:
One code map: an explicit conversion table, the port of Camel's type
converter (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.6 and 8.10). No
converter chains; a key with no entry raises `conversion.unmapped`.
The member stays small enough for CFG-YAML-6 so its content can move to
a digest-pinned data file without a format change.

entries.description:
The conversion entries; each key is the upstream's own code value,
the wire name the source system documents (CFG-ID-2).

ComponentKind.description:
A component kind, the ported subset of Camel's component library
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.8). `rest` is the facade
consumer; `direct` calls routes in process; `http` and `graphql` are the
upstream producers.

DefaultErrorHandler.description:
Camel's `defaultErrorHandler`: a redelivery policy nested under
`redeliveryPolicy`, as Camel's YAML DSL writes it
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7; CFG-NAME spelling inside).
`delayPattern` is not ported. Redelivery is per failing endpoint send,
as in Camel.

redeliveryPolicy.description:
The nested redelivery policy; the default carries no redelivery,
so the error propagates after the first attempt.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

onWhen.description: Narrow the clause with a predicate.

DoTryStep.description: A `doTry` step, ported as in Camel (`manual/try-catch-finally.html`).

doCatch.description: The catch clauses, in declaration order.

Eip.description:
An EIP a pack may require of the engine, named after the step union in
`crate::route` (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.6).

Endpoint.description:
One endpoint a route may send to: the component, the authentication
kind, the declared response headers, the endpoint operations with their
`idempotentUpstream` claims, and the tested upstream versions
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 6, 8.8, and 10.2).

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
The longest one attempt to this endpoint may take, in
milliseconds. Required, no default; a value above the platform
ceiling is refused, never shortened. The runtime binding may lower
it, never raise it.

authentication.description: The upstream authentication kind, with its non-secret parameters.

id.description: The endpoint identifier `http:` and `graphql:` URIs name.

maximumResponseBytes.description:
The largest response body one send to this endpoint may take in, in
bytes. Required, no default; a value above the platform ceiling is
refused, never shortened. The runtime binding may lower it, never
raise it.

operations.description:
The operations this endpoint serves, each with its
`idempotentUpstream` claim.

queryFile.description:
The GraphQL query file, from the pack's query-file inventory.
Required for a `graphql` endpoint.

requestHeaders.description:
The request headers the engine sends upstream on every send to
this endpoint, Camel's `HeaderFilterStrategy` as an allowlist,
unique (CFG-ID-6). Never allowlistable: the reserved header names
of `products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.11.4 and this
endpoint's own api-key header name.

responseHeaders.description:
The response headers the engine copies onto the exchange, Camel's
`HeaderFilterStrategy` as an allowlist, unique (CFG-ID-6).

testedVersions.description: The upstream versions this pack was tested against.

EndpointAuthentication.description:
The authentication kind a pack endpoint declares
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2): the kind tag itself, plus
only the API-intrinsic parameters (`headerName` for `static-api-key`,
`scheme` for `static-authorization`). Every credential value lives in
the runtime config, in [`RuntimeCredential`].

oneOf.description:
Nothing is sent. The checks admit it only for a numeric-loopback
origin or an endpoint with an mTLS client identity.

`Authorization: Basic` from the runtime's `usernameRef` and
`passwordRef`.

`Authorization: <scheme> <token>` from the runtime's `tokenRef`;
`scheme` defaults to `Bearer`, Evidence's spelling.

scheme.description: The RFC 9110 scheme the resolved token is presented under.

oneOf.description:
One declared header from the runtime's `valueRef`; reserved header
names are refused.

headerName.description: The header the key travels under.

oneOf.description:
The RFC 6749 client-credentials grant with a shared secret; the
runtime binds `tokenEndpoint`, `clientIdRef`, and `clientSecretRef`.

The RFC 7523 private-key-jwt grant; the runtime binds
`tokenEndpoint`, `clientIdRef`, and `clientAssertionKeyRef`. The
signed assertion always travels in the form body, as in Evidence,
so this kind carries no placement parameter.

EndpointOperation.description:
One operation of an endpoint, with the reviewed write claim
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.7 and 9): redelivery over a
non-safe send is admitted only when the endpoint operation declares
`idempotentUpstream: true`.

graphql.description:
The GraphQL operation kind the pinned query file declares, on a
`graphql` endpoint; a send naming this operation is safe only for
a query (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.8).

id.description: The operation identifier a `to` step's `operation` member names.

idempotentUpstream.description:
The reviewed claim that repeating this operation's send is safe,
for example an upstream create with client-supplied UIDs.

safeUpstream.description:
The reviewed claim that the upstream serves this operation's POST
as its safe search form, as FHIR servers serve `POST _search`
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.8): a route of a read
operation may then reach the send. The claim names POST only; a
PUT, PATCH, or graphql mutation send never reads it.

EnrichStep.description:
An `enrich` step: call a static endpoint and merge the reply. Static URI
only; no `pollEnrich`. Absent a strategy, the reply replaces the body
(Camel's default).

aggregateOnException.description:
Whether to aggregate the reply of a failed call (Camel default
false; failure propagates to the error handler).

parameters.description:
The request method, query, and operation, as a `to` send carries
them; the method's safety carries the write-safety rules of
`crate::checks`.

ErrorClass.description: A closed error class, the port of Camel's Java exception hierarchy (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7).

ErrorHandlerStep.description:
The route `errorHandler` step: `defaultErrorHandler` (no redelivery,
the error propagates) or `noErrorHandler`. Exactly one member is set.

defaultErrorHandler.description: The default error handler with its redelivery policy.

noErrorHandler.description: The no-op error handler: failures propagate untouched.

Expression.description:
An expression in one of the ported languages, externally tagged by
language name as in Camel's YAML DSL (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md`
section 8.5). `rhai` replaces Simple, Groovy, JavaScript, and `bean`.
A predicate is an expression whose result is a boolean; the runtime
never coerces.

Round-trip forms are covered beside the steps that carry them, in
`crate::route`.

oneOf.description: A literal JSON value, Camel's `constant` language.
A message header by name, Camel's `header` language.
An exchange property by name, Camel's `exchangeProperty` language.

An inline RFC 9535 JSONPath selector over the message body, as
Camel's `jsonpath` language but on the IETF standard.
A digest-pinned Rhai script and entrypoint.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

FilterStep.description:
A `filter` step: an inline predicate beside the guarded steps, as
Camel's Message Filter writes it. `CamelFilterMatched` records the
outcome; the route continues after the filter either way. Exactly one
language key must be present; `crate::checks` refuses zero or several
under an adapter code, and the reader refuses any unknown key
(`config.unknown-key`, CFG-SCHEMA-8).

statusPropertyName.description:
The exchange property that records the boolean outcome, absent by
default: Camel 4's `statusPropertyName`. Camel 4 sets no fixed
filter property, and neither does the port
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.6).

steps.description: The steps that run only on match.

GraphQlOperationKind.description:
The GraphQL operation kind an endpoint operation declares, as the
pinned query file writes it (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section
8.8).

oneOf.description: A read; the only kind that keeps a graphql send safe.
A write; non-safe under every write-safety rule.

HttpMethod.description:
An HTTP method a facade operation or an upstream send may declare. The
method decides send safety: `GET` is safe, the write methods are not
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.7 and 9).

IdempotentConsumerStep.description:
An `idempotentConsumer` step (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 9).
The key is namespaced by caller identity and concrete operation and
bound to the request digest; a duplicate replays the recorded facade
response; `skipDuplicate` is not ported.

completionEager.description: Release the key on completion (Camel default false).

eager.description: Add the key before processing (Camel default true).

expression.description:
The key expression, conventionally the caller's `Idempotency-Key`
header.

removeOnFailure.description:
Remove the key on failure before any upstream effect (Camel default
true).

Language.description:
An expression language a pack may require of the engine
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.5).

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

LoopStep.description:
A `loop` step (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.6 and 5.5).
Camel's shape with our bound: the count or predicate is the same flat
single-language-key form as `filter` and `when`, and `doWhile: true`
makes the expression a predicate loop (Camel's boolean flag, default
false). `maximumIterations` stays mandatory, a declared divergence:
the check refuses its absence and the runtime enforces it again.
Reaching the bound with a dynamic count above it, or a predicate
still holding, raises the catchable `loop.maximum-iterations-reached`
class, never a silent stop. Pagination is `loop` with `doWhile` over
the upstream cursor.

constant.description:
The `constant` language member: the iteration count, or with
`doWhile`, the predicate's constant form.

copy.description:
Whether each iteration works on a copy of the message (Camel
default false).

doWhile.description:
Camel's `doWhile` flag: true makes the expression a predicate
evaluated after each iteration; false makes it a count.

maximumIterations.description:
The mandatory iteration bound; the check refuses its absence and
the runtime enforces it again.

NoErrorHandler.description: Camel's `noErrorHandler`. The empty mapping `{}` is the whole variant.

OnExceptionStep.description:
An `onException` clause over the closed error-class hierarchy
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7). No clause may name an
uncatchable class; `crate::checks` refuses one that does. Redelivery
nests under `redeliveryPolicy`, as Camel's exception clause does in
YAML (`manual/exception-clause.html`, `manual/exception-redelivery.html`).

continued.description:
Whether the route resumes after the failure point (Camel
`continued`).

handled.description:
Whether the clause consumes the error (Camel `handled`). True ends
the exchange with the clause's result.

onWhen.description: Narrow the clause with a predicate (Camel `onWhen`).

redeliveryPolicy.description:
Redelivery options, as on the error handler, nested under
`redeliveryPolicy`.

steps.description: The steps the clause runs when no `when` matched.

RedeliveryOptions.description:
The redelivery option set, shared by the error handler and an
`onException` clause (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7; the
nesting under `redeliveryPolicy` follows Camel's own YAML DSL,
`manual/exception-clause.html` and `manual/exception-redelivery.html`).
Option spellings stay ours (CFG-NAME); only the nesting is Camel's.
Only the non-default members serialize.

backOffMultiplier.description:
The exponential multiplier (default 2); it grows delays, so the
reader refuses a value below 1 (CFG-QTY-4).

maximumRedeliveries.description:
Redeliveries after the first attempt (default 0; at most 100,
CFG-QTY-4).

maximumRetryDelaySeconds.description:
The delay ceiling in seconds (default 60); zero cannot bound a
delay.

retryDelaySeconds.description:
Delay between redeliveries in seconds (default 1); zero cannot
bound a delay.

retryWhile.description:
Stop redelivering early while this predicate holds (Camel
`retryWhile`). Divergence from Camel: the predicate only stops
redelivery earlier and `maximumRedeliveries` remains the hard cap,
where Camel lets `retryWhile` override it, so
`maximumUpstreamCalls` stays a check-time guarantee. The checks
refuse the predicate together with `maximumRedeliveries` 0, where
it could never fire.

ResumeBinding.description:
One resume binding of a non-safe send: the source-native identifier a
later step needs, read by an RFC 9535 selector and stored typed as an
identifier, never as an arbitrary value
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 9).

name.description: The binding name later steps reference.

path.description: The RFC 9535 selector that reads the identifier from the reply.

RhaiExpression.description:
A Rhai expression reference: the digest-pinned file from the pack's
script inventory and the precompiled entrypoint to call
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 5.6 and 8.5). Inline code is
refused (CFG-EMBED-1).

entrypoint.description: The precompiled entrypoint the engine calls.

file.description: The script file path, resolved against the pack's script inventory.

RouteDefinition.description:
A route as Camel's YAML DSL writes it: one `from`, `direct:` only, and
an ordered step list (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.3). Pack
templates carry the same steps without the `from`; the instantiated
route's `from` is `direct:<routeId>`.

id.description: The route identifier `direct:` targets and bindings name.

RouteTemplate.description:
A route template, Camel's `routeTemplate` without its `from`
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.4): the instantiated route's
`from` is `direct:<routeId>`, bound by the contract.

parameters.description: The typed parameters the template body references.

steps.description: The template body, with `{{name}}` and `{{?name}}` placeholders.

ScriptReference.description:
A script seam: code in its own file beside the pack, referenced by a
relative path and pinned by digest (CFG-EMBED-1). Scripts never carry
credentials and never construct URLs; the `http` component builds every
request from its declared template
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 5.6).

digest.description: The `sha256:` digest the file must hash to.

path.description: The script file, relative to the pack document.

SendUri.description:
The destination of a `to` or `enrich` send: a `direct:` route, an
`http:` endpoint, or a `graphql:` endpoint declared in the pack
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.3 and 8.8). The URI is static;
no `toD` is ported.

name.description: The header name; bounded and engine-validated.

SplitStep.description:
A `split` step (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.6 and 5.5).
`parallelProcessing`, `streaming`, and `timeout` are not ported.

aggregationStrategy.description:
The aggregation strategy; absent, the original message is returned,
Camel's default.

errorThreshold.description:
Camel's failure accounting: the share of failed pieces (a ratio
from 0 to 1) that stops the split.

expression.description: The expression that produces the pieces.

maximumFailedRecords.description: Camel's failure accounting: the maximum failed pieces.

maximumItems.description:
The mandatory piece bound; the check refuses its absence and the
runtime enforces it again.

steps.description: The steps applied to each piece.

stopOnException.description:
Whether a failing piece stops the split (Camel default false). A
non-safe send inside a split requires true. Exclusive with the
failure accounting below; the checks refuse both.

Step.description:
One step of a route body, externally tagged by the Camel EIP name
(CFG-ID-7). Every port-table row for Increments 0 to 3 has a variant,
so the format does not change when a later increment lands
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.10).

Step round-trip forms are pinned one per variant by the tests of this
module; each test names the Camel 4.x page the variant's semantics port
from.

oneOf.description: Send to a static endpoint or route. No `toD` is ported.
Set the message body from an expression.
Set the message body from an expression (Camel's `transform`).
Set one message header.
Set one exchange property.
Remove one message header by name.
Remove one exchange property by name.

Run an expression for effect on properties without changing the
body, as Camel's `script` EIP.
Content-based router: the first matching `when` wins.

Message filter: nested steps run only on match; the route continues
after the filter either way.
A failing predicate raises the `validation` class.
Stop routing the exchange.

Raise a closed error class now; the route's clauses handle it like
any error (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.11.6).
Split a message into pieces and aggregate them.
Repeat a block a bounded number of times.
Call a static endpoint and merge its reply.
Wrap steps in a resilience4j circuit breaker with `onFallback`.

Throttle sends; a waiting exchange waits at most until its
deadline, then raises `throttle.rejected`.

Wrap a write route in idempotent consumption
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 9).

The route's error handler: `defaultErrorHandler` or
`noErrorHandler`. The exhausted exchange is always journaled; the
journal is the fixed dead letter.
An exception clause over the closed error-class hierarchy.
`doTry` with `doCatch` and `doFinally` clauses.

StopStep.description: A `stop` step. The empty mapping `{}` is the whole variant.

TemplateParameter.description:
A route template parameter (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.4).
Divergence from Camel: typed and checked under CFG-VAL-9, where Camel
parameters are untyped strings.

defaultValue.description: The value used when the instantiation omits the parameter.

description.description: What the parameter means, for the reviewed pack.

name.description:
The parameter name, referenced as `{{name}}` or `{{?name}}`; a
local identifier, the same taxonomy an instantiation's binding
keys carry (CFG-ID-1).

required.description: Whether instantiation without the parameter is refused.

type.description: The value type checked at instantiation.

oneOf.description:
A flat, bounded string-to-string map, whose only use in a template
body is a whole-value `constant` placeholder.
Total requests per period (Camel default).
Concurrent requests.

ThrottleStep.description:
A `throttle` step (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.6).
Divergence: a waiting exchange waits at most until its deadline, then
raises `throttle.rejected`.

limit.description: The request limit per period, an expression as Camel 4 reads it.

mode.description: Total or concurrent requests (Camel default total).

rejectExecution.description:
Whether to reject immediately instead of waiting (Camel default
false).

timePeriodMilliseconds.description:
The period in milliseconds (Camel default 1000); zero cannot bound
a period.

ThrowExceptionStep.description:
A `throwException` step: raise one closed error class, with an
optional bounded constant message
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.11.6). The checks refuse a
boundary or facade class, which never enters a route.

exceptionType.description:
The closed class to raise; a catchable class, typically an
`outcome.*` class.

message.description: The optional constant message; no expression is ported.

ToParameters.description:
The parameters of an upstream send, Camel's `http` component options
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.8). The path template's
`{name}` segments are filled from `pathParameters` expressions and
percent-encoded by the engine as single segments; query members are
engine-encoded.

body.description: The request body expression, marshalled to JSON.

httpMethod.description:
The request method; an `http:` send declares it, a `graphql:` send
omits it. Its safety carries the write-safety rules of
`crate::checks`.

httpUri.description:
An origin-pinned link carried as an expression instead of `path`
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.11.5): at send time the
engine parses the value as an absolute URL and refuses it with
`egress.refused` unless it stays inside the endpoint's origin and
base path, carries no userinfo or fragment, and fits the URL
length bound. The checks refuse a send carrying both members, a
query beside this one, and this member on a non-http send.

okStatusCodeRange.description:
The inclusive status range treated as success (Camel default
`200-299`).

operation.description:
The endpoint operation this send invokes, when the pack declares
endpoint operations; write-safety checks read its
`idempotentUpstream` claim.

pathParameters.description:
Path-template segment name to expression; each key is a local
identifier (CFG-ID-1).

query.description:
Query parameter name to expression; each key is the upstream's
wire parameter name, an external identifier, because the key is
what the source system documents, not a name the pack defines
(CFG-ID-1).

resumeBindings.description:
The source-native identifiers a later write-resume step needs
(Increment 3; `products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 9).

throwExceptionOnFailure.description: Whether a failure status raises an error (Camel default true).

ToStep.description:
A `to` send: the static destination and its parameters
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.8). The `http` component
builds the request from the declared template; no expression can change
the origin or inject a path segment.

parameters.description: The send parameters; `direct:` sends carry none.

expression.description: The predicate; failure raises the `validation` class.

When.description:
One `when` clause of a `choice`: an inline predicate expression (the
language key sits beside `steps`, as Camel's YAML DSL writes it) and
the steps it guards. Exactly one language key must be present;
`crate::checks` refuses zero or several under an adapter code, and the
reader refuses any unknown key (`config.unknown-key`, CFG-SCHEMA-8).

steps.description: The steps the clause runs on match.

description:
The adapter pack artifact (`AdapterPack`), a per-source-system catalog:
endpoint declarations, route templates with typed parameters, internal
`direct:` routes, code maps, script references with digest pins, and
the required engine capabilities.

capabilities.description: The engine capabilities the pack requires.

codeMaps.description: The code maps routes convert values through.

id.description: The pack identifier a project pins.

queryFiles.description: The GraphQL query-file inventory, each file digest-pinned.

routes.description: The internal `direct:` routes shared sub-flows call.

scripts.description: The Rhai script inventory, each file digest-pinned (CFG-EMBED-1).

testedVersions.description: The upstream versions this pack was tested against, pack-wide.

version.description:
The pack's own version; a project pin names it next to the digest
(CFG-ID-4).

title: Registry Adapter pack
